name: tests
description: ``` npm i playwright && npx playwright install chromium   # once node tests/run.js            # all scenarios (~4 min) node tests/run.js zn pp br   # just some ``` The runner serves `game/` on port 8765 (`PORT=8766` to change), opens the game with `?local` (no Firebase), and runs each file in `scenarios/`. A scenario passes when it exits cleanly with no page errors. Screenshots land in `/tmp/dzd-tests` (`OUT=` to change).
